summary: Her model's memory cap and her measured rates. (1) The cap: her cap stays the owner's resident budget (what the memory rule admits and what the guard holds her resident memory to). On the processor, where the worker guard also limits address space (RLIMIT_AS), the limit is now the larger of her cap and her rung's estimate with M2's room (quick_model.cap_mb, reused: the estimate plus the larger of 2,048 MiB and half of it). The rung is the one her cap holds, and the room is that rung's, so they agree. local_brain._start_server passes it to brain_worker as the new --address-space-mb; the Radeon is unchanged. New workbench/brain_cap.py also works out, before loading, what the launch fields give her (Fits with room / Close / Fewer kept prompts / She will not load / Auto), with the numbers and the least cap that loads. The Brain room shows this line under the launch fields, and the model check's S0 says it and records it. (2) The rates: new workbench/tuning_rates.py. The model check's S2T (and the end of the run, for the pair's rates too) copies every rate the check remembered in its throwaway profile to tuning_rates.local.json beside the run. Once the check's workspace is closed, the check keeps them in this computer's profile (console runs too), and the Brain room keeps them again when the check it started ends. runtime_tuning.measured now notices a rates file written by another process. Live here (the 4B under the lock, CPU, 4,096 tokens): she loaded with an explicit 5,852 MiB cap near the 5,596 MiB estimate of the rung it holds. The guard's address-space limit was 8,394 MiB. She was sealed, primed 11 kinds, and PLAN's and READ's kept prompts were both KEPT. A PLAN turn was TAKEN in 4.5 s. She was still READY at the end: resident 4,694 MiB, address-space peak 5,632 MiB, so this short run stayed under the cap and did not reach the old limit. Then the model check ran from the console (S2T, a 20 s box) with the same cap. It carried and kept the plain launch's rates (reads 50, writes 5), and after it closed her clock's measured rates for her model's key went from None to (50, 5); her key equals the check's plain launch key. Nothing was tested in the owner's sense and nothing ran on the ThinkPad.

decisions: Her explicit cap stays the resident budget. On the processor the address-space limit gets M2's room above the rung's estimate (max(cap, quick_model.cap_mb(estimate))), and M2's rule is not applied to the budget itself. Reasons: what crashed in M2 was address space (std::bad_alloc under RLIMIT_AS), while resident memory stayed at the estimate (4,645 MiB at Ready against 4,669; here 4,694 against 5,596). M2's rule on the budget would refuse every explicit processor cap below estimate + max(2 GiB, half): 13,396 MiB for the 4B with every kept prompt, 38,994 MiB for the owner's 35B-shaped fixture even with no kept prompt. Or it would push the 4B onto a rung with no kept prompts, losing primed READ and PLAN. It would also change the 0.8.1 memory rules that about ten existing tests and campaign cases R07, R08 and R15 hold. With this design no test needs to change, and the formula is reused, not copied.

The limit applies to every launch on the processor (Auto, an explicit cap, the quick model, a Vulkan-to-CPU fallback), because it is worked out at launch from the backend actually used. Auto's and the quick model's budgets are unchanged; for the quick model the limit equals its budget, as before.

'Too tight' is said before loading in four plain states with the numbers: Fits with room (cap >= the room); Close (holds her estimate with every kept prompt but less than the room: resident memory past the cap is still stopped by the guard); Fewer kept prompts (a smaller rung); She will not load (with the least cap that loads and the cap that keeps every prompt). The refusal itself stays configuration's, unchanged.

The Brain room works the line out in its own process, as it already does with configuration for Use model. No new Kernel operation, so no registry change. It is worked out again only when the model, the launch fields, the saved defaults or the running worker change, not on the room's 1-second timer.

The rates are carried as everything the check remembered in its throwaway profile (each launch's key covers its launch line's shape, so each setting tried has its own entry and her clock finds the one she runs with). They are kept by the check itself once its workspace is closed, so console runs, which the acceptance evening uses with --tuning-seconds 900 and --quick, reach her clock too, and kept again by the Brain room as M2's keep_pair is. They are measurements in the profile, not settings. The model check's 'changes no setting of yours' still holds.
runtime_tuning.measured re-reads its file when the file changes on disk (a stat per call), so a window that is open while a console check finishes sees the new rates without a restart.
findings_for_the_coordinator: In this one live run the 4B's address space peaked at 5,632 MiB under a 5,852 MiB cap (rung estimate 5,596), so the run did not reach the old limit. The case M2 crashed in (address space past the cap as the prompt cache fills over some 60 questions) was not repeated here (one model run). The fix is shown by the guard on a tiny child (RLIMIT_AS 2,600 with a 600 budget) and by the live launch carrying --address-space-mb 8,394.

Auto on the processor gives a large model a budget equal to its estimate (31,930 MiB at 39 to 40 GiB for the 35B-shaped fixture). Before M1b its address space was capped there too. Now it gets 47,895 MiB of address space and the same budget. On the ThinkPad her 35B runs on the Radeon, where none of this applies, unless Vulkan falls back to the processor.

Resident memory can pass the memory sum's estimate a little (M2: 4,775 MiB after 70 questions against 4,669). A cap within that is stopped by the resident guard, not by address space. The Brain room's 'Close' line says so before loading. It is the estimate's accuracy, the same on the Radeon.

Here the 4B's plain rates (reads 50, writes 5 at 300/24 tokens) happen to equal her clock's stand-ins for a medium read, so in the live run the change shows as runtime_tuning.measured(her key) going from None to (50, 5). The stand-in run shows distinct numbers (47 and 67).

A console model check with --quick: its pair rates now reach her clock (carried and kept with the tuning stage's). Its exam results still reach the exam record only through the Brain room (quick_model.keep_pair needs the owner's Kernel), as A5's do.
The live READ request I chose was read by the dictionary (route MEANING), so no READ turn went to the model. READ's kept prompt was checked by a probe question (cache_n 649 of 651: KEPT).
The model check card's header still says 'Graphite 0.8.7' (version.VERSION; the version number is not mine to touch).
F2b (the window's thread): M1b does not touch the turn path. The Brain room's cap line calls configuration in the window's process, as its Use model button already did.
not_done: No live run where the address space actually crosses the cap (one 4B run under the lock was allowed); the long exam M2 crashed in was not repeated.
No READ turn to the model in the live run (the dictionary read the words); READ was primed and its kept prompt checked.
The live tuning stage had a 20 s box: only the plain launch was measured (the other trials NOT_RUN for the box).
The Brain room's keep in CheckPanel.finished was not exercised with a real check started from the window. The same keep ran in the console check, and the stand-in ran keep() directly.
No docs changed (the first-evening page could mention the cap line; X2 owns the guide). No test written or run; no window checks; nothing on Vulkan; nothing on the ThinkPad.
release_note: Her memory cap, said before loading. Under the launch fields, the Brain room now says what your Host budget gives her before anything loads: room to spare, close to her estimate, fewer kept prompts, or not loaded. It gives the numbers and the least budget that loads. On the processor, where the runtime reserves more address space than it uses, her address space may now reach her estimate with room above it, while her memory is still held to your budget. A budget near her estimate no longer runs out of address space as her kept prompts fill. The rates the model check measures in its tuning stage now reach her clock when the check closes, whether you start it from the Brain room or the console, so she prices her questions from what this computer measured.
